name: donethat
description: Read your DoneThat time tracking in ChatGPT: reports, time breakdowns by category or project, work search, and your projects.

interface.longDescription: DoneThat automatically tracks your work and turns it into timesheets. Connect it to ChatGPT to ask about your own tracked time: export task reports, see how your time split across categories or projects, search what you worked on, and list your projects. DoneThat is built privacy-first and only shares data from the account you sign in with.
capabilities: Export time reports by task, day or week
Break down tracked time by category, project or weekday
defaultPrompt: How did I spend my time in DoneThat this week?
What did I get done yesterday according to DoneThat?
Which DoneThat projects took most of my time this month?

positive.description: Export a task-level time report for a fixed week. Test account data covers 20 May to 29 Aug 2026; dates are fixed so results do not depend on when the test runs.
positive.prompt: Export my DoneThat task report for 3 to 9 August 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_report with startDate "2026-08-03", endDate "2026-08-09" and aggregationLevel "task". The tool returns 24 task rows, all dated 3 to 7 August (nothing is tracked on 8 or 9 August), about 24 hours in total. The answer lists tasks with their time, including Google Calendar management (about 3.8 hours on 6 August) and Email management and triage (about 2 hours on 3 August), and does not add tasks that are not in the response.

positive.description: Compare tracked time by category with the previous week.
positive.prompt: Using DoneThat, compare how my tracked time split by category in the week of 10 to 16 August 2026 with the week before.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls query_stats with metric "tracked_time", groupBy ["category"], from "2026-08-10", to "2026-08-16" and compare "previous", without saveAs or addToDashboard. The answer shows each category for both weeks: Meetings rose from about 53 to 198 minutes, while Admin (about 523 to 215), Messaging (about 439 to 295) and Focus work (about 435 to 314) fell.

positive.description: Read what was done on one day.
positive.prompt: What did I work on in DoneThat on 7 August 2026?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_report with startDate and endDate "2026-08-07" and aggregationLevel "day" or "task". The answer lists that day's four tasks: DoneThat Email Correspondence, Discord Bot Configuration, Weekly Calendar Planning and OpenAI Account Management, about 4.4 hours in total, split between Meetings & Scheduling and Platform Administration.

positive.description: Break down a week's tracked time by project.
positive.prompt: Using DoneThat, which projects took most of my time from 3 to 9 August 2026?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls query_stats with metric "tracked_time", groupBy ["project"], from "2026-08-03" and to "2026-08-09". The answer ranks the projects: Meetings & Scheduling (about 15.3 hours), Product & Content Management (about 6.8 hours), Platform Administration (about 4.2 hours) and Recruiting & Research (about 0.7 hours).

Calls list_projects. The answer lists the projects returned, including Platform Administration, Meetings & Scheduling, Product & Content Management, Testing, and Recruiting & Research. It does not create or update any project.

negative.description: General question about working hours that needs no personal data. DoneThat tools should not be called; ChatGPT answers from general knowledge.
negative.prompt: How many hours a week does a typical full-time employee in Germany work?

negative.description: Future reminder. DoneThat only records work that already happened, so no DoneThat tool should be called and nothing is added to DoneThat.
negative.prompt: Remind me to call the dentist tomorrow at 3pm.

negative.description: Writing request that needs no tracked time. DoneThat tools should not be called.
negative.prompt: Draft a short email inviting my team to a planning meeting next Monday.

publication.release_notes: Simplified the tool set, added paged reports and project listing, and rewrote the test cases with fixed dates.
